title: Baked Jamaican Fish
description: A flavorful and moist dish that combines the spices of Jamaica with the delicate taste of fish. Perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil.
Season the cod fillets with Jamaican jerk seasoning.
Drizzle with lime juice and brush with olive oil.
Place the fish on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the fish is baking, toss the roasted sweet potatoes with a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake the sweet potatoes in the oven for an additional 5-7 minutes or until tender.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
Serve the baked cod with roasted sweet potatoes and your choice of sides.
